lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Treat seeds with Mesorhizobium ciceri & PSB inoculants + Trichoderma @ 5g/kg seed.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check seed lot for wilt and collar rot history.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Use wilt-resistant cultivars (e.g. JG 11, Pusa 362, RVG 202).

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Conserve moisture with heavy wooden plank.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Basal application of DAP (20 kg N + 50 kg P2O5/ha) + Sulphur 20 kg/ha via gypsum.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check for soil-borne Fusarium wilt propagules.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Do not over-pulverize clay soils; gram prefers loose, rough tilth for aeration.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Ensure sowing at 7-10 cm deep into moist soil zone.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Drill basal fertilizers below seed level.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Deep sowing (8-10 cm) protects seedlings from early collar rot and wilt in dry topsoil.

lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: No top-dress nitrogen (nodules fix atmospheric N2).
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Collar Rot (Sclerotium rolfsii) and seedling mortality.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Avoid waterlogging; gram is extremely sensitive to excess root moisture.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Light irrigation at pre-flowering (40-45 DAS) only if soil is completely dry.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Optional 2% Urea foliar spray at 40 DAS if nodulation is weak.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for early Helicoverpa pod borer larvae on tender leaflets.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Perform 'Nipping' (plucking apical shoots at 30-35 DAS) to induce heavy lateral branching.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: Strictly avoid flood irrigation during peak flowering (causes flower shedding).
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Foliar spray of 2% DAP or Pulse Wonder @ 2 kg/acre to prevent flower drop.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Install Pheromone traps (Helilure) @ 5/acre and T-shaped bird perches @ 20/acre for pod borer.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Heavy watering at bloom triggers vegetative growth at the expense of pod setting.

lifecycle_stages.irrigation_guidance: 1 light irrigation at pod filling stage (70-75 DAS) in light sandy soils.
lifecycle_stages.nutrient_guidance: Foliar spray of 0:0:50 @ 1% for uniform bold seed size.
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout for Gram Pod Borer (Helicoverpa armigera) entering pods; count larvae per meter row.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Spray bio-pesticide (HaNPV @ 250 LE/ha or Bacillus thuringiensis) at early larval instars.

lifecycle_stages.stage_name_hi: 8. परिपक्वता (पौधे का सूखना व पीला पड़ना)
lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Check for pod rattling sound when shaken.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Harvest when leaves turn reddish-brown/straw color and pods are crisp dry.

lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Inspect threshed seeds for bruchid beetle holes.
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Harvest in morning to minimize pod shattering.

lifecycle_stages.pest_disease_scouting: Scout storage bins for Pulse Beetle (Callosobruchus chinensis).
lifecycle_stages.precautions: Sun dry gram seeds to <= 9-10% moisture before storing in clean airtight bins.
